improvements.rationale: These tags improve search engine visibility by clearly communicating what Gideon offers within the 155-character meta description limit. The OG and Twitter tags ensure professional, consistent previews when the homepage is shared on LinkedIn, Facebook, or Twitter—critical channels for reaching business professionals. Including the free trial and entry price creates a low-friction call to action without overpromising.

improvements.suggestion:
Hero Headline: "Meet Gideon — Your AI Trade & Business Partner"

Subheading: "Get instant answers, voice-powered support, and a dedicated workspace built for professionals. Try three searches free — no card required."
improvements.rationale: The headline personifies Gideon as a partner rather than just a tool, building trust and connection. The subheading hits three key value props (instant answers, voice chat, workspace) while clearly stating the free trial offer and removing friction by noting no card is needed. This combination addresses what Gideon does, who it's for, and the low-risk entry point — all critical for conversion.

improvements.suggestion:
Q: What happens after my three free searches?

A: Once you've used your three complimentary searches, you'll be invited to join as a member to continue accessing Gideon. Membership starts at just US$2 per day, billed monthly—or save 30 percent with an annual plan. As a member, you unlock unlimited searches, voice chat, and a dedicated workspace designed for serious business and trade professionals.
improvements.rationale: This FAQ directly addresses the most common friction point in the conversion funnel—what happens at the paywall. It reassures visitors that the free trial exists, transparently explains pricing without surprise, and highlights the value they unlock by upgrading. Clear expectations reduce bounce rates and build trust.
